title: Yoga for a Cause - benefitting Voices for Parkinson's
description: Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Voices for Parkinson's
long_description:
Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Voices for Parkinson's

About this Event

Come flow with us to benefit. Voices For Parkinson's provides in-person and telehealth speech therapy services for residents of Ohio. Individual, 1:1 services are currently provided at Alpha Neuro Fitness (800 E Ross Ave) in Cincinnati, OH. Weekly speech maintenance groups are offered via a hybrid approach, with the option for virtual and/or in-person attendance. The nonprofit organization offers a whole-person approach to treating the symptoms of Parkinson's disease, relating to problems with cognition, voice, and swallowing. We offer resources and education, and collaborate with an interdisciplinary team including local businesses to provide the most up-to-date information to our clients and their community.
100% of all donations go directly to the charity. We thank Fretboard Brewing for donating the space and Anissa Dowling for donating her time and talent in leading the yoga class that is always fun and perfect for all levels.
Bring a friend and enjoy $1 off beers in the tap room after class!

Also check out other in Cincinnati, Workshops in Cincinnati, Health & Wellness events in Cincinnati.
